copy.about_lead: CampConditions.au is a free digest of Victorian campground conditions, built for motorhomers, caravanners and campers by the team behind the YouTube channel Optimum Quest for Big Things.
copy.about_roads: Every camp page also has a Check road closures button. It opens VicTraffic, the Victorian Government's official live map of road closures and incidents. Check it before you head out.
copy.about_sources:
• Recreation Sites, Recreation Assets and Parks Victoria site pages supply facility details. Closure status stays with Parks Victoria.
  • Parks Victoria / DEECA MapShare closures on Recreation Sites.
  • OpenStreetMap campgrounds and towns (ODbL). These pages say to check with the operator. They are not given Parks Victoria closure data.
  • Bureau of Meteorology — linked only
copy.about_tail: VicEmergency warnings are not republished. Use the check button on each campground page, or call 1800 226 226. We don't copy reviews from other apps. Camper reports come directly from our readers. We don't publish a downloadable copy of the combined campground list.

faq.q: How do I know if a free camp in Victoria is open?
faq.a: DEECA Recreation Sites pages show the closure status and nearby Parks Victoria road and seasonal closures. OpenStreetMap campgrounds are not in that closure feed: the page says to check with the operator, and showgrounds say to call first. CampConditions.au does not republish VicEmergency warnings. Check VicEmergency, Parks Victoria and the Bureau of Meteorology before you travel. In an emergency call 000. The VicEmergency hotline is 1800 226 226.

The site rebuilds from DEECA and Parks Victoria sources several times a day. OpenStreetMap campgrounds and towns are refreshed weekly. Each page shows when it was built. Warning information is not included.
